svg.title: Beats from two waves of slightly different frequency
svg.desc: Two waves of equal amplitude and slightly different frequencies f1 and f2 (wavelengths λ1 and λ2), and their sum. The resultant alternates in time between destructive interference, where the waves are out of phase and it nearly vanishes, and constructive interference, where they are in phase and it has twice the amplitude: its amplitude rises and falls periodically.
